observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher explains the steps verbally while reading from a paper, then demonstrates the line and circle formations with the group. She breaks down the footwork counts and directions clearly before having the students practice together.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher reads instructions from a paper explaining Adana dance steps
Teacher explains arm placement and right/left footwork
Students line up with hands on shoulders and practice the steps
Teacher directs students to form a circle
Students practice the dance in a circle formation to music

steps_taught.name: Adana basic step
steps_taught.description: Step forward right, bring left forward, then step left two hops left

what_works: breaking down the steps slowly before music
what_hinders: reading from a paper instead of demonstrating face-to-face

quotes.text: So you're gonna be moving right.
Alright, so we'll start two fast and four slow.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates arm positions and foot direction while talking
Students line up holding shoulders and step side-to-side

extraction.distinctive_method: Reading dance steps directly from a paper list to instruct students
